description: Implementation of TraceLogger class for logging diagnostic events in the CalculatorApp, including window creation, mode changes, button usage, and exceptions.

classes.name: TraceLogger
classes.description: Singleton class responsible for logging diagnostic events related to the calculator application's UI and state changes.

methods.name: TraceLogger::GetInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of TraceLogger.

methods.name: TraceLogger::IsWindowIdInLog
methods.description: Checks if a window ID has already been logged.

methods.name: TraceLogger::LogWindowCreated
methods.description: Logs the creation of a new window.

methods.name: TraceLogger::LogModeChange
methods.description: Logs a change in the calculator mode.

methods.name: TraceLogger::LogHistoryItemLoad
methods.description: Logs loading of a history item.

methods.name: TraceLogger::LogMemoryItemLoad
methods.description: Logs loading of a memory item.

methods.name: TraceLogger::UpdateButtonUsage
methods.description: Updates and logs button usage statistics.

methods.name: TraceLogger::UpdateWindowCount
methods.description: Updates the count of open windows.

methods.name: TraceLogger::LogDateCalculationModeUsed
methods.description: Logs usage of date calculation modes.

methods.name: TraceLogger::LogConverterInputReceived
methods.description: Logs when converter input is received.

methods.name: TraceLogger::LogNavBarOpened
methods.description: Logs when navigation bar is opened.

methods.name: TraceLogger::LogGraphLineStyleChanged
methods.description: Logs changes in graph line style.
